conviction_note: Q3 2026 is new (no trading update, no resultatvarsel). The ~USD 700m FY guide was first given at Q2. With H1 at USD 357.8m it implies only about USD 171m a quarter in H2, against a Q2 of USD 192m and a USD 596m backlog, so a raise or a firmer guide is the likelier guidance event. That gives a mild lean up (p_up 55) on a name whose observed results-day moves run 13-30%, so abs_move is 12. The bar is unsourced: no Q3 consensus was found. Q3 is seasonally soft, the company itself guided H2 margins slightly lower, and KION's Q3 automation orders were flat. Those keep p_up near 50. impact_sum (+0.8) and the scaled number (+1.2) agree in sign and size.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide of ~USD 700m, given for the first time at Q2, implies H2 revenue of ~USD 342m (~171m a quarter) against a Q2 of USD 192.1m and a backlog that rose to USD 596.1m. A raise or firmer guide at Q3 is the more likely guidance event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The first guide plus a record quarter at Q2 2026 went with +19.08% on 2026-08-13. Prior results days: +13.52% (Q3 2025), +17.76% (Q4 2025), +14.50% (Q1 2026).
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public and sell-side FY estimates probably already sit above 700, after seven brokers raised targets on 2026-08-14. Even so, the stock has drifted from 16.3 to 14.9 NOK since early September and trades below THL's 15.60 ABB price. That does not look like a market positioned for a raise. Thin evidence, so small.
findings.independence: Placera, 2026-08-14: Deutsche Bank, Pareto, Nordea, SB1, Arctic, Citi and DNB Carnegie all raised targets after Q2, https://placera.se/nyheter/analytiker-hojer-autostore-efter-stark-rapport--2026-08-14 (sv: 'flera analyshus höjer sina riktkurser för Autostore efter ett starkt andra kvartal'). A snippet-only Affärsvärlden analysis calls the guide 'lite konservativ'; it is unverified.

findings.finding: The company itself guided that H2 investments will moderate margins slightly versus H1's 44.5% adjusted EBITDA margin, and Q3 is seasonally its softest revenue quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin dips have not driven recent reactions: Q2 2026's margin fell 2.7pp YoY and the stock rose 19%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, because it sits inside company guidance. Only an overshoot of the moderation would matter, hence near zero.

findings.finding: KION's Intelligent Automation Solutions (Dematic) Q3 2026 order intake was EUR 750.8m, +1.4% YoY. That is a flat Q3 for the largest listed warehouse-automation peer, though KION still expects the warehouse automation market to 'rise strongly in 2026'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: AutoStore's order intake headline has driven its last prints (record intake at Q2 2026, +19%); there is no measured peer read-through history.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a peer proxy, and KION's print was public a week ago. Dematic is also a different product mix, so transmission to AutoStore is a hypothesis. Small.

findings.finding: The non-discretionary buy-back (DNB Carnegie mandate) is buying ~550,000 shares a day (~NOK 8m, roughly 13-20% of daily volume) and kept buying through week 44, so it is a mechanical bid in the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Running since 2026-08-13; the stock has still fallen ~9% from its September highs, so the bid has not set direction.
findings.why_not_priced: It is disclosed weekly and largely priced. The only unpriced part is a possible top-up or new programme in the release, since ~NOK 473m of ~USD 75m is used. Small.

outside_window.finding: THL's 90-day lock-up on its remaining 853m shares (24.9%) runs from the ABB settlement (~2026-09-11) to about 2026-12-10, a further overhang after the window; the stock trades below the 15.60 ABB price.
The buy-back programme is due to end 2026-12-31; whether it is renewed after that is a later event.
